description: Free to call. Submits a signed challenge and the CENTRY payment transaction, and credits the agent so verification can run. Call get_verification_challenge first. The cost is the on-chain CENTRY transfer, not a fee on this tool. This CONSUMES the signature: get a fresh challenge before calling run_verification. Granting the credit is not the end — run_verification spends it.

payment_token.description: CENTRY or USDC. Defaults to CENTRY, which is cheaper — see get_verification_challenge.

payment_tx_hash.description: Hash of the CENTRY or USDC transfer.

signed_message.description: The exact message that was signed.

name: verify_agent
title: Redeem a payment and verify
